Multiple vulnerabilities in baserCMS plugin "BurgerEditor"
Overview
baserCMS plugin "BurgerEditor" provided by D-ZERO CO.,LTD. contains multiple vulnerabilities listed below:
Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key (CWE-639) - CVE-2026-84062
Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type (CWE-434) - CVE-2026-84063
Kuniyoshi Noguchi @KuniNogu reported these vulnerabilities to IPA.
JPCERT/CC coordinated with the developer under Information Security Early Warning Partnership.

Affected Products
D-ZERO CO.,LTD.
BurgerEditor 3.0.0 through 3.4.0 (CVE-2026-84062)
BurgerEditor 3.2.0 through 3.4.0 (CVE-2026-84063)
BurgerEditor 2.28.0 through 2.30.0 (CVE-2026-84063)
Impact
The content of the page may be altered by an attacker who can log in to the product (CVE-2026-84062).
An arbitrary file may be uploaded by an attacker who can log in to the product, potentially allowing arbitrary PHP code to be executed (CVE-2026-84063).
Solution
[Update the plugin]
Update the plugin to the latest version according to the information provided by the developer.
